en: Sepia-toned view along a riverside promenade with trees and pedestrians on the left and a bridge crossing the river toward a historic cityscape. A baroque-style church tower with an onion dome stands prominently on the right, with densely packed buildings at the base of a steep hill. On top of the hill are fortification structures and, to the right, a clock tower. The image caption at the bottom reads "GRAZ, an der Mur."
